pr_title: Fix Managed Local AI UI worker boundaries
pr_body:
## Summary

- carry one frozen Managed Local resource config through Managed Play capability planning and transition startup instead of resolving it twice
- retain ADR 0155 Enforced verification on the existing model-resource worker inherited from the repaired #909 dependency
- cover WindowsNative and Wsl2Linux Release/Reload worker-boundary behavior with a regression test

## Scope

This PR intentionally does not recreate the separate Send, GPU-layer, inference-error, or benchmark-campaign work in #909. It is stacked on #909's current repaired HEAD and contains only the remaining UI-thread/resource-transition work plus regression coverage.

No presentation/layout behavior changes; Visual Validation is not requested.
